name: Silverbough
descriptionSeed: Elven halls built into the high canopy of the southern forest, silver-barked and lantern-lit. You can walk a day beneath it and not know it is there; Greyspire's dwarves can see it from their walls and never let anyone forget it.
encounterFlavor: elven archers, canopy-walkers, and traders who came for the silverwood and were allowed up
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own forest (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind").
appearance: Silver-barked trees, bridges and halls in the canopy, lantern-light seen from below as a silver haze, and a rope-stair that is only let down for guests.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
